proof_obligations_for_a_replacement.PO-SOURCE: Show how the source state, inverse and required copies are physically produced with paid full-oracle queries.
proof_obligations_for_a_replacement.PO-GAP: Bound non-symmetry overlaps on the actual source law, including conditioning and physical error.
proof_obligations_for_a_replacement.PO-THEOREM-SCOPE: Check abelianity, normality, center/Baer index, subgroup QFT and actual theorem output separately.
proof_obligations_for_a_replacement.PO-REVIEW: Local dihedral/core/information identities remain independently unreviewed.
